items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I got a hold of all the music I could from Leeds and Clarence Williams and his various publishers

ctx.x: I was going to say too sorry that Big Spider back

but in the last 10 or 15 years Louis Armstrong is really the predominant influence and his Max Kaminsky had a theory about Bobby's playing which I think is very true he says Bobby Bobby sounds more like early Louis Armstrong Louis Armstrong the way Louis played with Clarence Clarence

Blue Five and behind the blues singers, it's very sensitive cornet type of expression. And he says, I think that's where Bobby got his whole style from. And Bobby loves to play Louis' tunes like Big Butter and Eggman and Someday and Barbecue. He always plays this thing. Cornet chops, silly. I guess he's the only one that still plays that tune.
